verdict: No production replacement. Windows narrow but point-error gains are not robust; naive means become overdue, phase matching has sparse support and added arrival-time jumps.

replayAudit.note: Current production detector/departure reducers, chronological raw observations only. No outcome table enters features. Red-only replay resets each day and after a per-bus gap over60s; ten-minute warmup required. Logged forecast clocks are15s buckets.
